scenes.script:
Prakash says: Har koi English confidently bolna chahta hai, haina?
Prakash says: Par hum actually karte kya hain? Bas passively videos dekhte hain, grammar books padhte hain, ya crowded classes join kar lete hain.
Prakash says: Aur phir sochte hain ki jab job-interview mein bolne ki baari aati hai, toh hum freeze kyun ho jaate hain.
Prakash says: Problem yeh hai ki yeh sab one-way learning hai. Aap sirf sun rahe ho, bol nahi rahe.
Prakash says: Bina apna munh khole aap koi bhi language bolna nahi seekh sakte.
Prakash says: Aur jab aap bolne ki koshish karte ho, toh bina mazaak udaye aapki mistakes correct karne ke liye kaun hai?
Prakash says: Bas isiliye humne banaya hai Supernova AI.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Want to speak English?
One-way learning fails
Supernova AI

scenes.script: Prakash says: Miliye Miss Nova se, aapki personal AI English teacher jo actually aapke saath baat karti hai.

Prakash says: Woh sabko same boring lessons nahi deti. Woh aapki speech ko analyze karke aapki weak areas dhoondti hai, aur aapke liye ek custom plan banati hai.
Prakash says: Aap real-life scenarios, jaise manager call ya interview, bilkul private mein practice kar sakte hain.
Prakash says: Raat ke 2 AM par hazaar mistakes karo. Woh aapko kabhi judge nahi karegi, na hi aap par hasegi.
Prakash says: Woh bas sunti hai, aapki broken English ko correct karti hai, aur aapki apni language Hindi mein logic samjhati hai taaki sab aasani se samajh aa jaye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Miss Nova AI Teacher
Personalized Plan
Zero Judgement
Real-time Feedback
Explained in your language

scenes.script: Prakash says: Din mein bas 15 minutes ki speaking practice kaafi hai.

Prakash says: Daily practice se, 1 month ke andar aapko apne confidence mein visible progress dikhne lagegi.
Prakash says: Toh ghanton feeds scroll karna band kariye, aur 15 minutes actually bolne mein bitaiye.
Prakash says: 1 crore+ Indians pehle se hi apni life badalne ke liye Supernova AI use kar rahe hain.
Prakash says: Peeche mat rahiye. Aaj hi Supernova AI install kariye.

Prakash says: Abhi Supernova AI app download kariye.
Prakash says: Install now par click kariye aur bolna shuru kariye.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been translated into natural, conversational, and highly code-mixed romanized Hindi. The hook successfully opens with a native word ('Har koi'). All numbers are kept as English numerals ('15 minutes', '2 AM', '1 crore+', '1 month') per the global rules. The language self-reference has been correctly swapped to 'Hindi' in Scene 3. The tone is polite yet engaging, perfectly matching the authority monologue register.

violations.why: The visual displays a fabricated user count of '50L+ USERS' instead of the approved '1 crore+ users' proof point.
violations.fix: Change the badge graphic in the visual to display '1 Crore+ Users' to align with the approved social proof.

safety.summary: The ad is highly compliant but contains an unapproved, fabricated user count badge ('50L+ USERS') in the Scene 5 visual.
